tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa dang e waṃ pa'i gdan rabs stabs cig pa'i gsol 'debs 'khyer bde bzhugs// rnam dag dkyil 'khor bzhi yi 'dzin ma sogs nas/ kun dga' bzang po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dkon mchog rgyal mtshan shes rab rgya mtsho dang*// rgyal tshab kun dbang dpal ldan rdo rje dang*// kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge dkon mchog 'phel// sangs rgyas rin chen rnams la gsol ba 'debs// lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub zhabs// buddha singha dkon mchog dpal ldan pa// brang ti nam bzang kun dga' bkra shis dang*// dpal ldan don grub rnams la gsol ba 'debs// nam mkha' sangs rgyas shes rab 'byung gnas dang*// nam rin bsod nams rgya mtsho dpal mchog mtshan// nam mkha' dpal bzang lhun grub dpal ldan dang*// sangs rgyas phun tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs// shes bya sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin tshul khrims dpal/ */'di man chad rgyu dbang tsam las lam 'bras yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa rgyun chags mi 'byung yang e waṃ pa'i gdan rabs kyis brgyud pa dang 'grigs che/ bsod nams dpal ldan byams pa bsod nams bzang*// bkra shis lhun grub tshul khrims lhun gyis grub// nam mkha' bsam 'grub rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan chos skyong sangs rgyas dpal bzang zhabs// bsod lhun mi 'gyur rin chen rgyal mtshan zhabs// dkon mchog grags sogs e waṃ gdan rabs su// rim byon dngos brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debs// bskyed pa phyi dbyibs rdul tshon dkyil 'khor sogs dang sbrel lo// zhes lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa dang e waṃ pa'i gdan rabs stabs gcig par gsol ba 'debs pa 'khyer bde 'di'ang*/ sde dge ban tshang mkhyen rab 'jam dbyangs pa'i ngag 'don rgyun 'khyer du/ bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas bris pa maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa la bstod pa mtshan spel bkra shis dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs//

༄༅// srid zhi'i skyabs kyi dam pa riṃn cheṃn gsum// kun 'dus bdag nyid sku gsung thugs gsang ba// miṃ 'gyuraṃ bdud bzhi'i dpung las rnam rgyal bar// dge mtshan gzi brgya 'bar bar zhabs brtan shog /riṃn cheṃn rgyud mangs 'khrol ba'i mtsho byung ma// ming tshig miṃ 'gyuraṃ phreng ba'i glur 'jo zhing*// dpal mgur sbrang rtsi'i rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn tshal du rtsen// theg gsum bstan pa smra ba'i mchog tu gyur// phyi nang shes bya'i gnas kun legs sbyangs pa'i// 'bras bu thams cad mkhyen pa'i riṃn cheṃn khrir// miṃ 'gyuraṃ bde bar son kyang smon lam dbang*// gzhan don la gzhol rgyal sras sems dpa'i tshul// 'khor 'das snang grag rig pa'i chos rnams kun// bden gnyis dbyer med rtogs pa ma 'gags gdangs// lha sngags ye shes 'khor los mnga' bsgyur bas// brtan g.yo'i khyab bdag chen po'i mtshan nyid rdzogs// 'gro ba'i re skong yon tan riṃn cheṃn la// 'dod 'byung nor bu khyod kyis do zla skyungs// mchog tu miṃ 'gyuraṃ go 'phang brnyes rnams kyi// 'bad med yon tan dag kyang 'gran gyis dogs// rgyal gsung mthun par 'chad rtsom brtsad pa yi// phrin las phyogs su rgyas 'dis yid srubs kyi// go sa nges par phrogs zhes gshe ba snyam// chos kyi rgyalaṃ mtshanaṃ bskal par brtan bzhugs gsol// mgon khyod bstod pa'i byin rlabs dbang gi chus// sgo gsum nyes ltung dri ma kun sbyangs nas// tshogs gnyis sdong bu stobs su rdzogs pa'i rtser// spangs rtogs snye ma g.yur za bdag byin rlobs// zhes mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa la bstod pa mtshan spel bkra shis dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang nyid kyis mos 'dun mchis pa'i khar/ phyag mdzod bla ma mkhas btsun shes rab bzang po pa'i gsung bskul gyis son par brten/ bstod yul dam pa'i legs gsungs bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu//

༈ //mkhyen brtse nus pa dpag yas dkon mchog gsum// kun 'dus bdag nyid dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// theg gsum smra mchog grags pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// rnam mkhyen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan slong la 'dud// srid pa 'jig rten mig gi thar pa dang*// thams cad mkhyen lam shin tu gsal mi byed// 'gro 'dul dbang po khyod gsung 'od brgya pas// yang dag lam kun snang byed khyad par 'phags// khyab 'jug rkang pa'i rdul dang drang srong gi /kha chus sbags pa med pa'i dbang bskur dang*// gdams pa'i gaṅgās 'gro ba'i phra rag chos// sku dang ye shes bsgyur ba'i rtsi chen byas// 'khor lo'i mgon po gang gi sku gsung thugs// dkon mchog gsum du rnam brtags yon tan rnams// lung las grags pa dpyod pas ring zhig ngal// skyabs kun 'dus zhal chen po'i zhabs la 'dud// bstod pas mgrin par brgyan bdag tshe rabs kun// tshul khrims rnam dag thos bsam bsgom byung gi /lung rtogs yon tan phung por dbang 'byor zhing*// skye 'gro phan bde'i 'byung gnas nyid gyur cig /ces mkhan chen dkon mchog grags pa'i rgyal mtshan pa la bsngags pa/ byin rlabs sbrang rtsi len pa'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mkhas btsun bla ma shes rab bzang po pa'i gsung bskul padma'i dri bsung gi son pa dang rang gi dad gus lhan cig pas bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //'phags mchog ngag gi dbang phyug go 'phang gi /dpag yas yon tan kun la dbang 'byor yang*// lung rtogs chos tshul skyong la mkhas btsun dang*// tshul bzang 'gro ba'i mgon por gyur la 'dud// 'di nas byang chub bar gyi legs pa'i lam// gsal bar mi byed snang ba'i mu khyud 'dis// khyod kyi legs bshad cha shas sgrun du ci// mkhas tshul rang nyid dper bstan 'dren mchog rje// mngar ba'i bsung ldang bsil ba'i go 'phang sbyin// lan dang rnam smin mi bsam ci 'dod dpal// rtag par 'jo ba'i dpag bsam yongs 'du 'di// nye bar thob pa'i 'gro 'di skal ba bzang*// rgyal bstan snying po sdom gsum 'khor du bcas// nyes med bzung nas gang 'dul gdul bya'i ngor// rang rang lta spyod bsgom pa'i rim par bcas// tshul bzhin 'doms khyod mkhas pa'i mchog tu khums// mdo rgyud bstan pa 'dzin mchog yon tan cha// bsngags brjod phul byung rgyan nam ma yin zhes// dpyod pa 'di ci rgyal kun ye shes nyid// 'gro 'dul sgyu ma'i rol par zhabs brtan bzhugs// dad pa'i don mthun bstod pa'i gru 'dir zhugs// tshogs zur rgya mtsho che brgal skyabs mchog gi

/gsang gsum byin rlabs nor bur dbang 'byor ba'i// grub gnyis 'dod dgu'i dga' ston 'byed par shog /lung rigs tshad ma'i dpang pos lan stong du// rab bsngags sa skya pa dang e waṃ pa'i// lugs bzang bshad dang sgrub pa'i dbyangs snyan bcas// nor 'dzin kun khyab rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces mkhan chen ngag dbang chos skyong bzang po par bstod pa bsod nams gru chen zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang gi mos 'dun gyi khar/ mkhas btsun dge ba'i bshes mchog shes rab bzang po pa'i gsung bskul gyi son pa'i ngor bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas 'dzoms thog rgyal khab tu bris pa bi dza yantu// // ༄༅// rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' rgya mtsho par bsngags pa byin rlabs gaṅgā'i klung 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs// /tshogs zung kuṃn gsal dga'aṃ ma'i 'gram pa las// legs 'phos sdom ldan mchog gi bsil sbyin mkhan// bstan 'gror sman 'dogs phrin las 'od dkar gyis// dge legs rgya mtshoṃ 'phel byed de la 'dud// tshul khrims bslab pa legs 'doms 'dul 'dzin mchog /brtse dang byang chub sems ldan rgyal ba'i sras// smin grol gdams pa'i dpal 'jo rdo rje 'chang*// rgyal ba'i phrin las skyong mchog khyod la 'dud// kun mkhyen gyis bsngags rdo rje slob dpon la// bstod pa byin rlabs gaṅgā'i klung 'jo zhing*// bsam bsgom yon tan myu gu bskyed bsrings rtser// don gnyis grub pa'i snye ma g.yur za mdzod// ces rdo rje slob dpon chen po kun dga' rgya mtsho par bsngags pa byin rlabs gaṅgā'i klung 'jo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang gi mos 'dun gyi khar nye bar gnas pa'i slob bu kun dga' lhun grub kyis bskul tshig gis son 'phral bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //yul mchog gyur rnams la skyabs su 'gro zhing 'dod don sbrang rtsi len pa'i dbyangs chung zhes bya ba bzhugs//

༈ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma dkon mchog gsum// yi dam kun 'dus lha mchog spyan ras gzigs// bar chad kun sel bstan srung nor lhar bcas// skyabs su 'gro bdag mkhyen brtse nus pas dgongs// bstan pa'i rjes 'jug ting 'dzin bzang po bdag /dad pa'i zhing sar dge ba'i sa bon bzang*// gang btab bag yod spyod pa'i so nam gyis// bskyed bsrings byang chub snye ma g.yur zar mdzod// mi dge'i bsam sbyor mi 'byung byung ba spang*// dge ba'i bsam sbyor ma skyes bskyed pa dang*// skyes pa gong 'phel 'byung bar skye 'di dang*// tshe rabs kun tu bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// zhes yul mchog gyur rnams la skyabs su 'gro zhing 'dod don sbrang rtsi len pa'i dbyangs chung zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dge slong ting 'dzin bzang po'i ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis sug bris su byas pa sarbārtha siddho bha wa tu// // ༄༅// skyabs gsum dbyer med gsol 'debs nyung bsdus bzhugs// ༄༅// ngag gi dbaṃng phyug kunaṃ dgaṃ'i lugs bzang phyir// bloṃ groṃs bstan pa'i rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn slong mchog dang*// tshul khrims brtul zhugs thos pa'i riṃn cheṃn yang*// dbyer med skye ba'i skyabs gzung byin gyis rlobs// ces 'jam dbyangs dang sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros tshul khrims rin chen gsum dbyer med pa la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'ang bla ma kun dga' bsod nams kyi ngor/ bande tshul rin gyis so// // ༄༅// zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen can la bsngags brjod zla snang 'bab stegs zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// dge tshogs mi dman yid bzang lam yangs nas// tshulaṃ khrimaṃs bslab pa'i dri bzhon shing rtar brten// gtsug lag rig pa'i cha rdzogs rgyal ba'i sras// phan sems riṃn cheṃn zla snang 'phro la 'dud// mdo sngags bstan par 'jug tshulaṃ bslab khrimasaṃ la// slob tshul 'chad rtsom brtsad pa'i phrin las rnams// sems can mos pa'i rjes song skyabs kyi mchog

/riṃn cheṃn gsum dngos sku tshe ring 'tshor shog /dkyil 'khor kun gtso dbyer med bla ma la// bsngags brjod bsod nams deng nas byang chub bar// dad dang nges 'byung tshuṃl khrimaṃs dag pa'i chur// yon tan riṃn cheṃn zla snang 'bab stegs mdzod// ces zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen can la bsngags brjod yon tan zla snang 'bab stegs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ nye ba 'khor gsar bu kun bzang grags pa'i ngor/ rang nyid kyis sug bris su bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// ༄༅// rang la bsngags pa byin rlabs 'dod pa'i dpal 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas 'dus pa'i dngos// tshul khrims bslab ldan thos bsam bsgom byung gi /yon tan rin chen snang bas bstan dang 'gror// sman 'dogs sgrub khyod bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /sgo gsum tha mal dngos po gsang chen rtsis// sku gsum rin chen gser du sprul bsgyur mkhan// smin grol gdams pa'i dbyig gis sems can gyi// re skong smra ba'i dbang phyug zhabs brtan gsol// tshul 'dis bstod pas mgrin par brgyan pa'i rgyud// bslab khrims rnam dag phyi nang rig pa'i gzhung*// bslab sbyang brtson pas yongs gzung phrin las kyis// bstan pa rin chen rgyas pa'i las byed shog /ces rang la bsngags pa byin rlabs 'dod dgu'i dpal 'jo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gling bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen rang gis zla ba gro bzhin 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor nyin sug dris su byas pa'o// ༄༅// ring 'tsho dang gsol 'debs don yod zhags pa zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// tshul khrims bslab gzhi'i 'chi med bum bzang can// phyi nang rig pa'i riṃn cheṃn rgyan gyis mdzes// rnam 'dren khyod sku tshe mtha' yas pa bzhin// bskal par brling zhing phrin las rgyas par shog /sangs rgyas gsung gi gsang ba mi zad dang*// mnyam 'dres 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i phrin las kyis// skye 'gro'i re ba 'gengs phyir bskal pa'i bar// 'gag med rdo rjes chos 'khor bskor bar shog

/brtse dang byang sems gnyis su med pa'i thugs// dpag yas shes bya'i gzugs snang 'bum bkra ba'i// rgyal kun ye shes me long ji bzhin du// sgrib bral rdo rje'i khams su rtag brtan gsol// tshul khrims rnam gsum lhur len bla ma dang*// rin chen gsum 'dus yi dam thugs rje che// dbyer med gsol btab byin rlabs dbang gi chus// bdag rgyud tshogs zung myu gu bskyed bsring mdzod// gsol 'debs don yod zhags pas sbrel ba gang*// yang srid kun du dal 'byor rten thob cing*// dam pas rjes gzung shes bya'i gnas la sbrin// lung rtogs dam pa'i chos la dbang 'byor shog /ces rang gi ring 'tsho'i gsol 'debs don yod zhags pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ a mye mgon rgyal gyis bskul ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen rang gis sug bris su bgyis pa'o// ༄༅// rdo rje 'dzin dbang bzang po bkra shis par bsngags brjod me tog 'phyang 'phrul bzhugs// ༄༅// bskal pa bzaṃng poṃ'i thub gsung chu gter gyi// snying po sdom gsum bdud rtsi'i bcud len brten// rnam grol phyogs chos rga shi med brnyes pa'i// bkraṃ shiṃs mtshan bzang legs bris bdag por 'dud// rgyud gsum dregs pa'i mnga' bdag nag po che// mkhas btsun bzaṃng poṃr grub pa'i rnam rol gyis// srid zhir bkraṃ shiṃs byed pa'i phrin las bzhi// lhun grub rgyun chags 'byung ba de la 'dud// bsngags brjod las bzaṃng mgrin snyan sgyur byed po// mthong ba'i chos dang yang srid thams cad du// chos smra mchog gis legs gsungs rjes sgrub cing*// lung rtogs dpal gyis 'byor pa'i bkraṃ shiṃs stsol// zhes rdo rje 'dzin dbang bzang po bkra shis pa la bsngags brjod me tog 'phyang 'phrul zhes bya ba 'di ni/ slob 'bangs bsod nams dpal 'byor gyi ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis sug bris su bgyis pa sarba maṅga laṃ//

༄༅// chos rje rin chen lhun grub par bsngags brjod dge legs 'byung sgo zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// mkhyen brtse nus mtha' lha rdzing ring mo dang*// mnyam par klas pa dkon mchog rin chen gsum// kun 'dus rgyal ba'i phrin las lhun grub dang*// rgyun chags skyong ba dpal ldan bla mar 'dud// mdo sngags bstan pa'i rin chen 'byung gnas kyi// snying po sdom gsum bdud rtsi yongs bzung nas// 'gro tshogs rnam grol 'chi med gsos 'gyed pa'i// mdzad bzang lhun gyis grub khyod zhabs brtan shog /gang zhig dad pa'i sa gzhir yon tan char// bsngags brjod dge ba'i sa bon btab pa'i rgyud// dam tshig sdom pa'i dbyar skyes dar bab rtser// dngos grub zung gi 'bras bus dud par shog /ces chos rje rin chen lhun grub pa la bsngags brjod dge legs 'byung sgo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ slob bu shākya bstan 'dzin gyi ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du bris pa'o// //skyabs mchog riṃn cheṃn gsum 'dus gang gi zhabs// miṃ 'gyuṃr bstan pa'i dar gos lhab lhub rtser// rnam par bkod 'dis gzhan sde dgos mi 'tshal// mkhas rnams dgyes pa'i rgyaṃl mtshaṃn brtan gyur cig /kun mkhyen baṃstan pa'i brjod bya yongs 'dziṃn cing*// sna tshogs gdul bya'i blor 'tsham 'doms pa la// bsnyeng bral lag na rdoṃ rjeṃ'i rjes 'gro las// gzhan pa'i dper 'os 'jig rten dkon la 'dud// tshulaṃ khrimaṃs bslab pa'i yid 'phrog rgyan gyis spras// mkhas tshul gsum gyi 'chi med zil dngar 'jo// yon tan riṃn cheṃn gser gyi bum pa bsnams// phrin las sku tshe dpag yas de la 'dud// su zhig bstod pa'i rgyud mangs 'khrol ba der// 'dren mchog rnam gsum byin rlabs gzhon nu yis// dad gsum dge ba'i mgron du khugs gyur nas// 'di phyi'i don bzang dga' ston rtsen par shog

/skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad sogs nas dam tshig la gnas shog ces pa'i bar brjod ces 'dren mchog rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bstan 'dzin rdo rje/ bande tshul khrims rin chen rnam pa gsum la bsngags brjod yi ge'i rgyud mangs zhes bya ba 'di ni btsun pa bkra shis tshe ring gi bskul ba'i ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'dzoms thog pho brang nas lhag pa lag sor phrad pa'i nyin bris pa'o// // ༄༅// rab 'byams sangs rgyas bzang po pa la bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i gling bu zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// dpag yas tshogs gnyis chu gter bsrubs pa'i bcud// sangaṃs rgyaṃs kun dngos 'dren mchog mkha'i rna ba// dam pa'i phrin las bzangaṃ poṃ'i zla snang gis// bstan pa'i 'dab stong bzhad pa la phyag 'tshal// dpag bsam yid bzhin nor bu'i mchog gi dpal// sbyin min sangaṃs rgyaṃs sgyu 'phrul khyod dran gyis// gnas skabs mthar thug bde 'byor bzaṃng poṃ la// sbyor bas khyad par 'phags nyid brtan bzhugs gsol// sras bcas rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs bla ma la// bstod dbyangs gling bu 'khrol gang skye nas skyer// tshul khrims rnam dag gtsug lag rin chen gyi// snang bas srid pa'i rmongs pa 'phrog byed shog /ces dpal sa skya pa'i bka' lung phrin las kyi snang chen 'gyed pa'i rab 'byams sangs rgyas bzang po pa la bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i gling bu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ legs gsung bdud rtsis bgo skal nod pa'i bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis gus par sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅// dus 'khor bla ma kun dga' phun tshogs pa la bsngags pa dad dga' rgyas pa'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rgyal gsung thos pa'i bdud rtsis bskyed pa'i bu// bsam bsgom rtogs pa'i lang tsho dar la bab// mang thos kun dgaṃ'i khri la mnga' bsgyur ba'i// phuṃn tshogaṃs dge legs dpal gyis 'byor la 'dud// kuṃn mkhyen bstan pa'i snying po yongs bzung ba// rim dang cig car sdom pa'i dga'aṃ ston la// lus can mgron gnyer mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpal// phunaṃ tshogasaṃ 'den pa mchog khyod rtag brtan gsol// mtshan nyid kuṃn ldan slob dpon che ba'i cha// bsngags brjod dad dga' rgyas pa'i mgrin 'jo bas// sa lam yon tan phunaṃ tshogaṃs dbang 'byor zhing*// rgyal ba'i bstan la mkhas pa'i las byed shog

/ces dus 'khor bla ma kun dga' phun tshogs pa la bsngags pa dad dga' rgyas pa'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ smin byed chos kyi skal ba bzang ldan bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas bris pa swa sti bi dza ya tu// // ༄༅// rang bstod blo gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// ngagaṃ gi dbaṃng phyug grub pa'i mchog rnams las// tshulaṃ khrimaṃs bslab pa blangs nas phyi nang gi /gtsug lag riṃn cheṃn snang bas 'jig rten gyi// dge legs 'dab brgya bzhad pa de la 'dud// rigs drug rgyal ba sems dpa' bgegs kyi dgra// de dag dga' mar bcas pa'i rnam rol gyis// 'gro bar legs pa'i lam ston 'jam dpal dbyangs// tshul khrims rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes la 'dud// tshulaṃ 'dis bstod pa'i rten 'brel dge bas bdag /bslab khrimaṃs rnam dag thos bsam bsgom byung gi /blo gros riṃn cheṃn shel dkar me long ngos// lung rtogs yon tan gzugs brgya bkra bar shog /ces pa'i rang bstod blo gsal me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ slob bu bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi ngor bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas 'phral du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// bha wa tu// // ༄༅// zhabs brtan gsol 'debs bkra shis dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// sarbārtha siddhirbha wa tu/ gang mtshan 'dzin cing gsol gdab snyan dngags glus// mchod tsam bskal par bsgrub dka'i mngon 'dod kyang*// skad cig sbyin pa dkon mchog yon tan gter// rdo rje'i slob dpon zhabs brtan dge legs stsol// snang byed 'od khyab byi ru'i lhun po bzhin// dge mtshan 'bar ba tshe mtha' yas pa kye// bla ma'i sku tshe rdo rje'i ka ring bzhin// brtan byed thugs rje'i skyabs byin phyag rkyongs shig /tshe sbyin sgrol mas 'khor lo'i gur khyim du// mchog sprul nyi bu'i bdud las rnam rgyal phyir// thugs rje'i myos bum rgyas pa'i zil dngar gyis// 'chi med ring 'tsho'i sku tshe bsod nams bskyed// skyabs gsum 'dus sku 'gyuraṃ medaṃ kunaṃ bzangaṃ gi

/sangs rgyas ji bzhin bdud las rnamaṃ rgyalaṃ te// bloṃ gsaṃl 'khor tshogs rgyaṃ mtshoṃ 'dus pa'i dbus// sdeṃ snoṃd smra ba'i mchog tu brling bar mdzod// gsang gsum 'pho bral nam mkha'i sgeg mo las// smin grol nyi zla'i rna cha ches g.yo bas// bstan 'gro'i dge legs nyin mtshan 'dab brgya'i mchu// 'dzum du dmul ba'i ga zha 'byin par mdzod// padmā ka ra'i thugs bcud kyis mtshon pa'i// gsang sngags gsar rnying bstan pa yongs 'dzin pa// gang gi phrin las nor 'dzin dga' ma'i bzhin// yongs su khyab pa de srid brtan par bzhugs// gang sku bskal par brling bas gser ri dang*// legs gsungs rtag 'jo rgyun babs gaṅgā'i sgra// byams brtses 'gro ba phyogs lhung med bskyangs pas// legs bris lam gyi rjes 'gror zhabs brtan shog /zla bas spros pa'i dug dang kun gsal ngos// dral ba'i dum bu ji bzhin dkon mchog gsum// bden dpang gsol ba'i smras don snying po kyang*// nam yang med par mi 'gyur bden pas skyongs// zhes ze chen sprul sku 'gyur med kun bzang rnam rgyal blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sder zhabs brtan gsol 'debs bkra shis dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sgo mi ka bcu kun bzang rgya mtsho pa'i gsung bskul gyis son par chos smra ba'i bande tshul khrims rin chen zhes bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ ༈ /na mo ྅ gha siddhā ya/ dbang bskur gdams ngag dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig bsdus 'jam dpal dbyangs// tshad med thugs rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs// mthu chen lag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal// bdag gzhan sdig pa kun bshags dge la rang*// don dam sems bzung mchog gsum skyabs su 'gro// gzhan don byang chub thob phyir lam la 'jug /dge bas bla med byang chub thob phyir bsngo// de srid skye bar dal brgyad 'byor bcu ldan// rigs gsum mkhyen brtse nus pas rjes bzung nas// shes bya kun rig brtse dang byang sems 'byongs// bstan dang sems can phan 'dogs bzod par shog

/ces rigs gsum mgon la yan lag bdun pa 'bul zhing 'dod don gsol ba 'debs pa bsam don lhun grub ces bya ba 'di'ang gzungs srung gi kha bton du bande tshul rin gyis so// // ༄༅// ring 'tsho'i gsol 'debs rga shi med pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rgyal ba tshe dpag med mgon rta mgrin dbang*// pad 'byung thang stong rgyal po brgyud bcas la// gsol ba 'debs so tshul khrims rin chen rje// tshe lo bskal par bsring ba'i thugs gtad gsol// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa'i// tshe bcud thugs rje byin rlabs yongs bsdus nas// ngag gi dbang phyug grub pa'i bskal pa brgyar// tshe sogs dbang bcur thob pa'i go 'phang sbyor// gsol btab dgyes dgongs bla ma bzhi khro yi// rnam rol 'chi med ye shes bdud rtsir zhu// tshul khrims lhur len gtsug lag rin chen mang*// rga shi med par rtag pa'i dngos grub stsol// brtan bzhugs gsol btab dge ba'i nyi gzhon gyis// bdag sogs blo yi 'dab stong grol ba las// phyi nang rig pa'i bcud mngar ches 'thungs pa'i// legs bshad bung ba'i dbyangs snyan stong 'jor shog /rgyal ba de sras bcas pa'i bstan pa dang*// bstan skyong rnams kyi phrin las dge 'dun bcas// 'char ka'i nyi 'od dang 'grogs mtshams sprin gyi// dmar 'od khyab bzhin sa steng mdzes gyur cig /ces kho bo cag ring por 'tsho ba'i gsol 'debs rga shi med pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mgon khang bla ma kun dga' bsod nams pa'i gsung bskul ma stong tsam du ngag dbang tshul khrims rin chen rang gis bris pa sarbārtha siddhaṃ bha wa tu// //skyabs gsum 'dus pa dpal ldan ngag gi dbang*// tshul khrims lnga rig rin chen gyis bklubs pa// lung rigs rtogs pa'i glegs bam ral gri 'chang*// bstan pa'i snang byed 'jam dbyangs rtag brtan gsol// ces brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha 'gengs 'di'ang dge slong dkon mchog dbang phyug gi ngor tshul rin gyis so//

༈ /bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i bka' lung dang*// padmā ka ra'i thugs bcud gsang ba'i sngags// bstan pa 'dzin 'chad rtsom pas gsal mdzad pa'i// mgon khyod snying nas gsol 'debs da tshur dgongs// 'dren mchog gzugs sku 'od gsal dbyings brtul nas// chos sku'i yon tan dpag yas dbang 'byor yang*// gdul skal sems can btang snyoms mi bor bar// mchog sprul myur du 'byon pa'i dgongs pa gtod// snying rje'i bdag nyid gzhan don 'gyur srid na// byang chub thob kyang dor nas don mdzad phyir// mgon med 'gro la phan chen 'byung nges pas// ljongs 'dir sprul sku mi 'byon ci ste bzhugs// gang phyir skye ba dam pa'i mi sbyin skyes// mtha' klas shes bya'i mkha' la bgrod mkhas shing*// mkhas tshul gsum gyi snang bas spyi bye brag /bstan pa'i 'dab stong bzhad pa'i dus la bab// dkon mchog bka' lung ldan pa'i shing rta dang*// gzhan don bskul ba'i kha los mdun bsu bas// 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i sku yi yid bzhin nor// lus can bsod nams khang par khug gyur cig /ces ze chen sprul pa'i sku padmā gsang sngags bstan 'dzin pa'i gzugs sku'i bkod pa brtul ba'i skabs su sprul sku myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs dgos don nor bu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di ni/ tshul rin gyis mos gus rtse gcig tu bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
